reply_text:
Gideon, your first report in #inc-vtg-hartford was at **10:42 AM on 3 Aug**: "gate kiosks offline at Vantorre's Hartford plant. Both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan. Guard is writing trailer numbers on a clipboard."

In the meantime, the guard was logging trailers by hand on that clipboard. Mateo's 11:03 AM message says the guard checked in trailer 8836 once kiosk 1 was back, so the manual check-ins continued until then.

Two other points for the postmortem:
- Kiosk 1 was back at 11:03 AM, and you posted at 11:08 AM that both lanes were working as of 11:07.
- The SUP-5380 ticket has an earlier log entry at 08:12: "Rebot failed; drivers queueing. Checking conn. now." I can't see who wrote that entry from here, so please check whether it was you before using it as the first report.
